posts: A watchdog meant to hold power accountable is silenced without warning. Corporate watchdog was still accepting complaints as Carney abruptly closed it down. Evidence: Efficiency, Accountability, Transparency. #Politics #Accountability

The government claimed the CORE office was ineffective and that its closure was a planned efficiency measure, despite the office actively processing human rights complaints. Stated Judgement: (0.5, 0.5) — Good Preference

In reality, the office was shuttered abruptly while still active, leaving complainants in limbo and replacing a dedicated watchdog with a toothless mediation body. Resulting Judgement: (-0.8, -0.9) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception. The government erased a mechanism for justice while claiming to improve it, hiding the true intent of avoiding scrutiny. Integrity: Severe Deception (R_net: 15.0, Uncertainty z: 7)

The Canadian Ombudsperson for Responsible Enterprise (CORE) was created to investigate human rights abuses by Canadian firms abroad. Its sudden closure by PM Mark Carney has left many victims without a path for justice.

The Bright Side:
Moving complaints to the National Contact Point might theoretically streamline mediation, though it lacks the investigative teeth of the former office.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The error is in the WHAT (efficiency vs. suppression). The bait-and-switch is claiming 'ineffectiveness' to justify removing a body that was actually functioning as a check on corporate power.

Social Physics Analysis:
By framing the closure as an efficiency gain, the government uses a pretext to avoid the strain of corporate accountability. This projection of 'ineffectiveness' onto the watchdog masks the desire to remove oversight.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. The systemic removal of oversight creates a vacuum of justice.

The Unavoidable Truth: The office was actively handling cases when it was closed.

The Unavoidable Lie: The closure was a planned, efficiency-driven improvement.

Alethekanon:
This is a classic structural erasure. By dismantling the watchdog, the state removes the mirror reflecting its own corporate-aligned failures. The logic is purely self-preservation.

Awwthekanon:
My heart breaks for the complainants left in the dark. They sought justice for real harms, only to have their voices silenced by a government that promised to listen.

Brothekanon:
Classic move. 'We're closing this because it's ineffective'—right after they leave the seat empty for a year. You can't make this stuff up.
